messages:
Samir (AE): CharterPay POC kickoff scheduled 3/14. Scope: streaming ingestion of transaction text -> model tool call (tx-normalizer) -> structured JSON output. Need SDK examples, streaming handshake runbook, security questionnaire responses, and rough pricing for hosted vs dedicated.
Maya (Solutions Eng): I'll build minimal SDK examples in Go/Python and a tiny Node snippet for function calls. Will include a JSON Schema for the normalized transaction.
Tara L. (Security): Send the questionnaire. Summary answers: SOC2 in place; customer-managed KMS available in Dedicated/Private; hosted uses server-side keys; EU region data residency supported; audit logs available with configurable retention. I'll draft precise wording.
Oliver K.: Streaming pattern recommendation: use SSE or chunked framed messages. If you need atomic JSON per event, base64-encode the payload in each frame. Suggested event framing: {event: "partial_output" | "tool_call" | "final_output", payload: "..."}. Backpressure: use connection close + retry window and client-side buffering limits.
Maya (Solutions Eng): Sample Python request for function call: {"messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Normalize: Amt $12.50; 01-08-24"}], "tools": ["tx-normalizer-v1"]}. I'll add parser examples mapping schema fields to their DB columns.
Samir (AE): Pricing ask: estimate for 100k steady tokens/day, spikes to 300k. Need a ballpark for SOW.
Maya (Solutions Eng): Rough: hosted generation ~$0.0008/token (model-dependent). Dedicated reserved nodes can reduce per-token ~35-50% depending on utilization and quantization. Include commit term caveat.
Oliver K.: I'll draft the streaming handshake runbook tonight with example Go client showing scanner over resp.Body and reconnection logic. Also add a small perf appendix about batching and KV cache reuse to save tokens.
Tara L. (Security): Legal likely wants pen test summary; I'll request it from Security Ops and add to the deal folder. Also confirm support for ephemeral creds in streaming for short-lived sessions.
deploy-bot: Runbook created at https://redwood.internal/runbooks/charterpay-poc (access: sales, solutions).
Samir (AE): Can we have runbook + SDK snippets + security blurb + pricing ballpark by EOD tomorrow? Tech sync with client 3/15.
Maya (Solutions Eng): Yes — I'll push drafts to the Deal folder and include a tiny test harness that validates schema and simulates 500 RPS.
Oliver K.: I'll include fallback routing notes (auto-fallback to quantized variants, multi-region reroute) for availability sections in SOW.
Samir (AE): Thanks team. If SSO cert rotation or ephemeral creds become blockers, flag here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
Maya (Solutions Eng): Final bundle will be posted here when ready. :rocket:
